leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a feature flag function that checks if a feature is enabled
Construct a feature flag configuration object with variant values
Initialize a feature flag utility with default and custom configurations
Apply conditional logic to render different UI components based on feature flags
Manipulate feature flag states to toggle features on and off
Integrate feature flags into a simple application to control feature visibility
Configure feature variants to enable A/B testing scenarios
lessonTitle: Build feature flag utility with variants
